title: Jazzy Bouncy Mexican Yogurt Tacos
description: A unique and delicious Mexican-inspired dish featuring full-fat yogurt for a rich and bouncy texture, suitable for Buddhist temple-friendly diets. This dish is perfect for adventurous eaters looking for a twist on traditional taco fare.
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine hominy, grilled corn kernels, diced mango, lime juice, honey, cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and crushed red pepper. Place the saucepan over medium heat and bring to a simmer.
Cook the mixture for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the flavors have melded together and the mixture is heated through.
Meanwhile, warm the full-fat plain yogurt by placing the container in a bowl of hot water for 5 minutes.
Once the yogurt is warmed, stir in chopped cilantro and divide it among four serving bowls or tacos.
To assemble the tacos, place a spoonful of the warmed yogurt mixture into the center of each bowl, then top with a spoonful of the hominy-corn-mango mixture.
Serve the Jazzy Bouncy Mexican Yogurt Tacos immediately, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
